BOOK ONE · LESSON 096

What's the exact time?

确切的时间是几点？

A written-exercises lesson on exact times and the expression 'in ...'s time'. There is no dialogue. The lesson presents a grid of twelve clocks showing different times, a reference table of time phrases (a minute, an hour, a day, a week, a month, a year — with AGO and IN ...'S TIME forms), and fifteen city pictures (Athens, Beijing, Berlin, Bombay, Geneva, London, Madrid, Moscow, New York, Paris, Rome, Tokyo, Stockholm, Sydney, and a bus station) used for the question 'When did he / will he go to ...?'. Written exercise A rewrites 'must' sentences using 'had better'; written exercise B answers questions using 'in ...'s time'. Workbook practice covers writing the exact time for six clocks (A), answering 'When will you ...?' questions using the time phrase in brackets (B), and writing what you would say in two situations (C). Grammar exercises practise answering questions with past and future time expressions (I) and answering questions about the exact time (II).

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen and answer the questions.
听录音并回答问题。

When did he / will he go to ...?
他曾／将在什么时候去……？

Listen to the recording and answer the questions. When did he go to [each city]? When will he go to [each city]?

Twelve clocks showing different times of day. Read each clock and say the exact time.

十二个显示不同时间的钟。读出每个钟的准确时间。

Notes on the text 课文注释

Time phrases with AGO and IN ...'S TIME

a minute / two minutes AGO · an hour / two hours AGO · a day / two days AGO · a week / two weeks AGO · a month / two months AGO · a year / two years AGO

IN: a minute's / two minutes' TIME · an hour's / two hours' TIME · a day's / two days' TIME · a week's / two weeks' TIME · a month's / two months' TIME · a year's / two years' TIME

Fifteen cities: Athens, Beijing, Berlin, Bombay, Geneva, London, Madrid, Moscow, New York, Paris, Rome, Tokyo, Stockholm, Sydney, and a bus station.

十五个城市：雅典、北京、柏林、孟买、日内瓦、伦敦、马德里、莫斯科、纽约、巴黎、罗马、东京、斯德哥尔摩、悉尼和汽车客运站。

A — Rewrite these sentences using had better. 用 had better 来改写以下句子。

Rewrite these sentences using had better. 用 had better 来改写以下句子。

Example:
We must go back to the station.
We had better go back to the station.

Rewrite each sentence using 'had better' instead of 'must'.

7 items (6 numbered questions plus a printed example). Item 1 is a printed example. These are written exercises from the textbook; answers are suggested model answers.

B — Answer these questions using 'll. 模仿例句回答以下问题，用上 'll。

Answer these questions using 'll. 模仿例句回答以下问题，用上 'll。

Examples:
I went to Beijing a year ago. What about you? (a year's time)
I'll go to Beijing in a year's time.

Tom flew to Stockholm two weeks ago. What about Pamela? (two weeks' time)
She'll fly to Stockholm in two weeks' time.

Dave and Alan returned to Tokyo two days ago. What about you and Jean? (two days' time)
We'll return to Tokyo in two days' time.

Answer each question using 'will' and the time phrase in parentheses.

4 items. Answers are suggested model answers based on the pattern shown in the examples.

02

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Practice 练习

A — What's the exact time?

Write the exact times under these clocks following the style of the example. 模仿范例写出时钟上显示的时间。

Example: 9:16 → sixteen minutes past nine

Write the exact time shown by each clock, following the style of the printed example.

6 clocks. Item 1 is a printed example. Items 2-6 are taken from the supplied Lesson 96 key (img/key-095-100.jpg).

B — When will you ...?

Answer these questions using the words in brackets with the word time. 用括号中表示时间的短语和 time 来回答以下问题。

Example: When will they go to Beijing? (a month)
They'll go to Beijing in a month's time.

Answer each question using the time phrase in parentheses with 'time'.

5 items. Item 1 is a printed example. Items 2-5 are taken from the supplied Lesson 96 key (img/key-095-100.jpg).

C — Situations

Read the situations. What do you say in each? 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。

1. You want to know the time, but you want it exactly. Ask a friend.
2. You think that you and some friends should walk to school, and not go by car or bus.

Write what you would say in each situation.

2 items. Both answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 96 key (img/key-095-100.jpg).

BUILD YOUR FOUNDATION

Grammar 语法练习

I. Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词回答下列问题。

Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词回答下列问题。

Example (item 1):
What did you do two minutes ago? (meet Jane)
I met Jane two minutes ago.
What will you do in two minutes' time? (meet Jack)
I shall meet Jack in two minutes' time.

Answer each pair of questions using the cue given, following the printed example.

II. Answer the questions, using the times given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的时间回答下列问题。

Answer the questions, using the times given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的时间回答下列问题。

Example (item 1):
What's the exact time? (5:02)
It's two minutes past five.

Answer each pair of questions using the time given in parentheses, following the printed example.
